querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      relation,
                                      guarantor,
                                      relation2,
                                      securedparty,
                                      method,
                                      amount,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      term,
                                      start_dt,
                                      end_dt,
                                      is_complete,
                                      is_related,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      report_period,
                                      is_overdue,
                                      overdue_amount,
                                      is_counterguarantee,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareguarantee.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareguarantee WHERE ann_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
